_: M4 INTEGRATION — one dark capture per deeps level, proving data/ambience.json's
__: five new deeps_* entries are applied by the running game and that each level is
___: still readable with them on. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/m4_dark.json

_: NO --darkness OVERRIDE ANYWHERE IN HERE, on purpose. Ambience.darkness_override
__: would force every level to the same alpha off the command line, which proves the
___: mechanism and nothing about the file. Each shot below is the level's OWN entry:
____: 0.88 / 0.70 / 0.84 / {0.74, flicker 0.12, rate 1.4} / 0.88, with each level's own
_____: authored pools and emissive tiles. A wrong entry shows up as the wrong darkness.

_: GOTCHAS, inherited from the five authoring sequences: settle 210 after a scenario
__: or the level-title card is still over the room; a teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of the
___: body on the tile's top-left, so aim one row above the stand row and let her drop;
____: and a bare {"settle": n} is a no-op — settle is a modifier on scenario/teleport.
